test.title: Asking a former teacher for a reference

document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
after: You do NOT need to write any addresses.

text: I hope you are keeping well. I am writing to ask whether you would be willing to write a reference for my application to study Environmental Science at university.

As you may remember, you taught me biology for my last two years at Riverside College, and I finished the course in June with an A. Since then, I have been working at a garden centre while I prepare my application, and I have also volunteered at a local nature reserve.

I have chosen to apply to Northfield University, where students spend a year working on real conservation projects. I would really appreciate it if your reference could mention my field project on river insects, which you supervised, as it shows my interest in this subject.

The application deadline is 15 January, and the reference can be uploaded directly to the university website. I would be happy to send you a copy of my personal statement and any other information that might be helpful.
Thank you very much for considering my request.

note.en: Politely reminds the teacher of the connection.
Moves from the past to the present.
Two things happening at the same time.
Specifies what makes this university special.
Here as = because: why the project should be mentioned.
note.kk: Мұнда as = because: жобаны неге атау керек.
note.ru: Здесь as = because: зачем упомянуть проект.

note.en: Adds an offer to send more.

strengths.en: Subject, years and grade — just enough for the teacher to remember.
strengths.kk: Пән, жылдар және баға — мұғалім оқушысын есіне түсіруге жететіндей.
strengths.ru: Предмет, годы и оценка — ровно столько, чтобы учитель вспомнил ученика.

title.en: A reminder, not a life story

strengths.example: you taught me biology for my last two years at Riverside College

strengths.en: The writer suggests what to include in the reference and explains why.
strengths.kk: Жазушы ұсыныс хатқа нені қосу керегін айтып, себебін түсіндіреді.
strengths.ru: Пишущий подсказывает, что включить в рекомендацию, и объясняет почему.
strengths.example: mention my field project on river insects

strengths.en: The deadline, how to send it and an offer of materials make it easy to help.
strengths.kk: Мерзімі, жіберу тәсілі және материал жіберуге дайындық — мұғалімге көмектесу оңай.
strengths.ru: Срок, способ отправки и готовность прислать материалы — учителю легко помочь.

strengths.en: “Whether you would be willing” and “I would really appreciate it” show respect for a former teacher.
strengths.kk: «whether you would be willing», «I would really appreciate it» — бұрынғы мұғалімге құрметпен.
strengths.ru: «whether you would be willing», «I would really appreciate it» — уважительно к бывшему учителю.
strengths.example: whether you would be willing to write a reference

note.en: A former teacher, by surname: semi-formal.
A polite start and the request in the first paragraph.
note.kk: Сыпайы басталу және өтініш — бірінші абзацта.
note.ru: Вежливое начало и просьба — в первом абзаце.

note.en: Bullet 1: a reminder of who is writing — subject, years, result, what came next.
note.kk: 1-тармақ — кім жазып отырғанын еске салу: пән, жылдар, нәтиже, кейін не істеді.
note.ru: Пункт 1 — напоминание, кто пишет: предмет, годы, результат, что делал после.

note.en: Bullets 2 and 3: where the writer is applying and what to include in the reference, with a reason.
note.kk: 2 және 3-тармақтар — қайда түседі және ұсыныс хатта нені атау керек, себебімен.
note.ru: Пункт 2 и 3 — куда поступает и что упомянуть в рекомендации, с причиной.

note.en: Practical details: the deadline, how to upload and what else could help.
note.kk: Практикалық деректер: мерзімі, қалай жүктеу керек, тағы немен көмектесуге болады.
note.ru: Практические детали: срок, как загрузить, чем ещё помочь.
Благодарность за то, что учитель рассмотрит просьбу.

document.title: Asking a former teacher for a reference
bullets: remind the teacher who you are
explain what you are applying for
say what you would like the teacher to include
document.question:
You are applying for a place at university and need a reference.

Write a letter to a teacher who taught you in the past. In your letter
